scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @asi/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @asi/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @asi/contracts && npm run build --workspace @asi/config && npm run build --workspace @asi/database && npm run build --workspace @asi/research
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @asi/web && npm run build --workspace @asi/worker
scripts.ops:status: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; exec npx tsx scripts/ops-status.ts'
scripts.start:web: npm run db:migrate && npm run start --workspace @asi/web -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
